text:
arjun: quick sync we need a simple playbook for preserving billing keys & meaningful spans during heavy ingest spikes. posting a pragmatic proposal.
kelly: TL;DR?
arjun: keep: error spans, transactions with billing keys, any span with tag preserve=true. degrade: verbose debug spans and high-cardinality metrics. aggregate noisy counters. preserve billing keys in an envelope header so even if body is dropped we still account.
peter: can you paste the example rules we can drop straight into staging?
arjun: sure (psuedo-config):
```yaml
ingest_policy_version: 1
preserve_headers: [billing_project, billing_team, billing_key]
rules:
  - id: preserve-errors
    match: "span.status >= 400 || span.attr.critical == true"
    outcome: keep
  - id: short-debug-drop
    match: "service == 'debug-frontend' && span.duration_ms < 2 && sampled == false"
    outcome: drop_with_header
  - id: noisy-counter-agg
    match: "metric.type == 'counter' && card_estimate > 10000"
    outcome: aggregate_then_drop
    aggregation_window_ms: 5000
```
kelly: drop_with_header means we copy headers to envelope but delete payload?
arjun: yes. envelope contains minimal billing keys + a trace_id stub. downstream consumers can still do cost attribution.
sage: curious about client-side impact. if we drop payload, will APM UIs show missing spans?
arjun: we'll emit a lightweight stub span with attr.observed=true and attr.drop_reason = "policy_drop". displays can grey those. we also emit metrics: ingest.policy.kept, ingest.policy.dropped, ingest.policy.aggregated by service.
peter: copying headers early where? edge proxy?
arjun: edge ideally. if edge can't, we plan a best-effort enrich step in the gateway with a fast LRU lookup keyed off request token.
kelly: are we sure that header copy doesn't leak PII or sensitive tags?
arjun: only allow an explicit whitelist of billing keys. no user identifiers. plus tenant opt-out flag per account. default: whitelist enabled.
sage: how do we tune thresholds? static thresholds are painful.
arjun: propose an adaptive controller: set soft_limit = 0.8 * capacity, if queue depth > soft_limit increase drop bias; cool down over window. add safety clamp for error-bearing traces so we never drop errors regardless of load.
peter: can we test on replay? I can run a 72h sample against spike scenarios and report per-service drop ratios + billing attribution fidelity.
arjun: please do. add a column for "billing_mismatch_rate" where we compare attributed tenant from dropped vs original.
kelly: ops-bot, can you confirm whether canary has the proxy hook deployed?
ops-bot: canary-proxy: version 2.14.0 includes header-copy opt-in flag; currently disabled in canary config.
kelly: let's flip flag in canary after peter's replay. also add an alert rule: if ingest.policy.dropped[%] > 30% for 5m, page infra.
sage: any thoughts on storing aggregated counters? retention change?
arjun: aggregated buckets are cheaper; propose keeping 90 days at coarse resolution then roll up to 1y at reduced fidelity. will add to storage impact section.
peter: next steps: 1) run replay and post CSV, 2) sage to draft UI behaviour for stub spans, 3) arjun to add policy examples + controller tuning to RFC follow-up. aim for staged canary in 10 days.
kelly: thanks, small doc please so SREs can review runbook. :thumbsup:
